summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the PR changes and the overall risk.

findings.description: Empty when the diff has no issue that meets the criteria in CLAUDE.md.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file (never a position inside the diff); null for a file-level finding.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state that triggers it, and the wrong result.

suggestion.description: The smallest change that fixes it.
